storytellers.title: Steady
storytellers.name: Old Wenna Hearthwarden
storytellers.character: Tells her tale slowly by the fire, and always leaves you time to catch your breath.
storytellers.text: Foes gather slower and raid less often and with fewer blades. Help comes sooner when the town is hurting, and there are longer quiets between troubles. Townsfolk break less often.

storytellers.title: Rising
storytellers.name: Corvin Ashmantle
storytellers.character: A bard of slow-building dread: every act a little darker than the last, and a climax you can feel coming.
storytellers.text: The game as it was meant to be played: quiet beginnings, rising threats, and a hard last act.

storytellers.title: Chaotic
storytellers.name: Jinny Two-Dice
storytellers.character: Rolls whatever she likes, whenever she likes: feasts and fires, windfalls and warbands, all in the same week.
storytellers.text: Raids come early or late and far bigger or smaller than you expect; foes grow in fits and starts. Strangers ride in with gifts out of nowhere, and so does trouble. More stories, more inspirations and more breaks.
